create_QAgent: create a QAgent with a model and number of actions for discrete action selection
run_QAgent_call: run one step of the QAgent to select an epsilon-greedy action from observations
update_QAgent_model: update the QAgent model by loading a new state dictionary
create_QMLP_network: create a QMLP neural network with linear layers for action scoring from observations
create_DQMLP_network: create a DQMLP network with dueling architecture separating value and advantage streams
